title: Fracture-Informed CNN-Transformer Ensemble for Multiclass Photovoltaic Defect Segmentation in Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: SegFormer-B0 with an edge-guided residual-logit refiner (probability, uncertainty, Sobel cues) soft-fused with a compact U-Net++ branch (weights 0.55/0.45).
adaptation: Heterogeneous ensemble: house 5-seed U-Net++ ensemble plus a SegFormer-B2 (1024 px) or EoMT member; fusion weight chosen on val per class group (crack, inactive, rest); refiner idea optional.
min_experiment: Arm house 5-seed ensemble + SegFormer-B2 member vs house 5-seed ensemble; metrics crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, E1 relF1@2; kill if no metric improves beyond its noise floor fold-paired (crack IoU 0.012).
evidence: R: 5-class EL set (dataset unverified), ensemble mIoU 0.840, non-background mIoU 0.804, defect mIoU 0.779 internal test; gains over refined SegFormer confirmed by paired bootstrap.
prior_overlap: none: BRIEF lists heterogeneous ensembles as never tried; only same-architecture 5-seed ensembles were run (the one clear win).

alt_notes.adaptation: Train a tiny refiner on out-of-fold 5-seed ensemble probabilities, entropy, Sobel magnitude and the image, using the existing module-grouped 5-fold roots so the refiner never sees in-fold predictions.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: 5-seed ensemble + OOF-trained refiner. Baseline: 5-seed ensemble at argmax (crack IoU 0.485 to 0.488). Metric: crack IoU, mIoU_rob. Kill if crack IoU < +0.01 or mIoU_rob drops.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add one non-RN34 member (SegFormer / ConvNeXt / DINOv3 from D23-D24) to the 5-seed ensemble with per-class fusion weights fitted in CV; diversity by architecture since more RN34 seeds saturate (E1 +0.001 when doubled).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: 5 house + 5 transformer (or 3+3 at equal compute), CV-fitted per-class weights. Baseline: 10-seed RN34 ensemble. Metric: crack IoU, E1 relF1@2, inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.008 crack IoU and < +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
